supported_hashes.description: List of default hash algorithms to show in the GTK interface; must be subset of: MD5, SHA1, SHA256, SHA512, RIPEMD, HAVAL, TIGER, WHIRLPOOL

auto_generate.description: Whether to automatically compute checksums when a file is dropped into the window

show_advanced.description: Whether to expose less common hash algorithms (HAVAL, TIGER, WHIRLPOOL, RIPEMD) in the UI

verbose.description: Enable detailed logging when gtkhash is run from command line
